## Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please verify the following:
- [ ] Code formatting has been run (`black .`)
- [ ] Code linting has been run (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Static types check successfully (`mypy src`)
- [ ] All tests pass successfully (`pytest`)
- [ ] Coverage levels have not decreased

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has been updated
- [ ] Backward compatibility is preserved
